sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast a podcast to practice English listening for beginners.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客，這是一​​個為初學者練習英語聽力的播客。

sentences.en: Today I will talk about the weather.
sentences.tc: 今天我要談談天氣。

sentences.en: I like hot weather I prefer hot weather over cold weather.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡炎熱的天氣 比起寒冷的天氣，我更喜歡炎熱的天氣。

sentences.en: What do you prefer the Heat or the cold?
sentences.tc: 熱和冷你比較喜歡哪一個？
